title: 3153. Sum of Digit Differences of All Pairs

examples.explanation: We have the following: - The digit difference between 13 and 23 is 1. - The digit difference between 13 and 12 is 1. - The digit difference between 23 and 12 is 2. So the total sum of digit differences between all pairs of integers is 1 + 1 + 2 = 4.
All the integers in the array are the same. So the total sum of digit differences between all pairs of integers will be 0.
